names: W05 follow-up: in the synthesis figure trace, a bare 'sales' (no modifier before it and no noun after it) names the Revenue row and a bare 'profit' the profit rows (EBITDA, EBIT, net income), any of which it may mean, so 'while sales were $7,178M' (EBIT's figure) and 'profit was $60,372M' (revenue's) are refused; a qualified word or a compound ('comparable sales', 'open-market sales', 'sales leverage', 'profit per share', 'segment profit') still names no row; the comparison guard compares a figure's rows less their rate variants. On the 27 committed pages no flag moves
